messages.text: For employees.hire_date, do we use ORIG_HIRE_DT or LAST_HIRE_DT?
hire_date should come from LAST_HIRE_DT, not ORIG_HIRE_DT. Tenure is measured from the current period of employment. ORIG_HIRE_DT maps to original_hire_date.
first_name in people analytics is the name people go by: use PREF_FIRST_NM, not LEGAL_FIRST_NM. Fall back to the legal name when the preferred name is blank.
engagement_score: engagement surveys run in a separate survey platform that never fed the HRIS, so there is no source for engagement_score.
fte = FTE_PCT / 100. The HRIS stores a percentage, the target stores a fraction.
